title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz
seo_title: Mahj Mondays at the Gillioz in Springfield, MO
description: Mahj Mondays is a free open play night for American Mahjong at The Gallery at the Gillioz, presented with Blooming Bams. You can drop in or stay the whole time; players of all skill levels are welcome, but you must already know American Mahjong (NMJL rules) and bring your own 2026 NMJL card. Several tile sets are provided, BYO food is welcome, and the Gallery Bar will be open; it takes place Monday, December 7, 2026, from 5:30 to 8:30 PM at 325 Park Central E., Springfield, MO, and an RSVP is requested via the Facebook event.
